text_block_list.text:
The crowd goes wild as Эйр Грув
conquers the
Japanese Oaks and carries
on her mother's
legacy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A new queen has been crowned, and Air
Groove
stands proud before her
cheering fans.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Добер, who had been struggling
with her
self-esteem, watches Air
Groove run and realizes
she wants to be
just like her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Next up is the Shuka Sho, and the newly
crowned
queen has no intentions of
slowing down.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
